basic_info.description: Located in Bernal Heights, this charming single-family home offers a flexible split-level layout, abundant natural light, and a private yard that feels like an extension of the living space.  The main level welcomes you with a bright living & dining area, where natural light filters through and a fireplace creates a comfortable focal point for gatherings. From here, the space flows into a thoughtfully designed kitchen, complete with a Viking gas range, plentiful cabinetry & glass-front display cabinets that add both function and charm. A skylight overhead brings soft light throughout the day, and French doors extend the living space outdoors to a sunny deck & fenced yard perfect for a morning coffee or evening w/ friends.   Upstairs, 2 bright bedrooms share a full bathroom w/ a skylight & outlooks across the neighborhood to the Bay. The lower level has a 3rd bedroomideal for guests, a home office, or creative spacealong w/ internal access to the 1 car garage (plus driveway space), where you'll find w/d & storage. With charming curb appeal, Bay views, an outdoor retreat & ample street parking, this Bernal Heights home offers comfort & convenience.
